before0000000000.description:
You attempt to hide from one or more creatures. To hide from a creature, you must have cover or concealment from them, and they must not be observing you. During combat, if you use this maneuver while you have cover or concealment from a creature who isn't observing you, you are automatically hidden from them unless the Director deems otherwise.

While hidden from a creature, you can't be targeted by their abilities that don't have the Area keyword, and you gain an edge on ability rolls against them. You are no longer hidden from a creature once an activity that reveals you resolves: using an ability, interacting with an enemy, moving without sneaking, or otherwise revealing yourself.

@UUID[Compendium.draw-steel-combat-tools.rules.JournalEntry.DSCTrulesJournal.JournalEntryPage.DSCTfullHiding00]{Full rules: Hiding and Sneaking}

Combat Tools: the Hide button on this card hides you from every enemy you have concealment or no line of effect from. Cover alone needs the Director's nod: the Stealth panel lists who is still observing you, and Hide from Targeted adds them.
